title: Justicia propone al CNIAPGE modernizar el Registro Civil de Guinea Ecuatorial para reforzar la seguridad jurídica
why_not: On 26 May 2025 the Ministry of Justice asked CNIAPGE to update the digital platform 'Registro Civil' (marginal notes, a QR code on certificates); the text names no office using it, and the date is before the twelve-month window.
